The run used the OpenAlex bulk snapshot (2026-09-23; 476{,}196{,}327 works; 129.4 million base works 1995--2022) and identified 12{,}499 concepts by Aho--Corasick title matching of 56{,}643 legacy OpenAlex concepts (levels 2--5) plus Wikidata aliases, with stemmed verification and a per-concept LLM precision gate ($\\geq 0.80$).\n\nThe run addressed two research questions:\n\\begin{itemize}\n    \\item \\textbf{RQ1:} Which early co-occurrence network indicators predict size-adjusted cross-field breadth beyond a five-feature popularity baseline?\n    \\item \\textbf{RQ2:} Do concepts spread next to fields related to those currently retaining them, extending the principle of relatedness?\n\\end{itemize}\n\nThe primary outcome is rarefied field breadth $O_{2r}$ ($m = 50$): the expected number of distinct venue fields among a fixed-size random draw of $m$ papers from a concept's publications in years $t_0 + 6$ to $t_0 + 8$.\n\nTwenty artifacts were commissioned across five iterations; sixteen completed and four failed. Each iteration's strategy, review and hypothesis update are recorded in the sections that follow.\n\n\\begin{figure}[!htbp]\n  \\centering\n  \\includegraphics[width=\\linewidth,height=0.85\\textheight,keepaspectratio]{figures/fig_overview_v0.pdf}\n  \\caption{Overview of the study design. (a) Concept identification: 56,643 legacy OpenAlex concepts are matched by title (Aho--Corasick) against a 476.2M-work OpenAlex snapshot, giving 60.0M verified matches; concepts are onset-dated ($t_0 \\in$ 2003--2014), required to have early volume $\\geq 30$ and to pass an LLM precision gate $\\geq 0.80$, yielding an analysis panel of 12,499 concepts. (b) Panel structure, bar lengths proportional to concept counts: DEV (blue; CS, Eng, BGM and Med homes, onset 2003--09) 4,771, held-out field groups (grey; onset 2003--09) 3,372, and the 2010--14 onset cohort (green) 4,356. The expanded lower bar splits the held-out block into PHYS 742, LIFEENV 1,113, SOC 1,352 and MATHDEC 165. The panel contains 27,393 concept $\\times$ off-home-field episodes over 26 venue fields; a separate fresh 2015--17 onset cohort of 1,443 concepts serves as a confirmatory frame. (c) Indicator screen for the breadth outcome (O2r\\_m50). Bars are coloured by indicator family with lengths proportional to indicator counts: 53 early indicators computed over $t_0..t_0{+}2$; 48 eligible on DEV; the 10 frozen on DEV; and the 7 confirmed on held-out units. (d) The two research questions.}\n  \\label{fig:overview}\n\\end{figure}\n\n\\subsection{Panel composition}\n\n\\begin{table}[!htbp]\n\\centering\n\\caption{Panel composition (from Experiment~5, iteration~2). DEV concepts have home fields in Computer Science, Engineering, Biochemistry/Genetics/Medicine. Held-out groups cover the remaining field families.}\n\\label{tab:panel}\n\\small\n\\begin{tabular}{lrr}\n\\toprule\nSplit & Concepts & Episodes \\\\\n\\midrule\nDEV (CS/Eng/BGM/Med, onset 2003--2009) & 4{,}771 & 9{,}079 \\\\\nCohort (onset 2010--2014, all fields) & 4{,}356 & 9{,}799 \\\\\nHeld-out Physical Sciences & 742 & 1{,}662 \\\\\nHeld-out Life \\& Environment & 1{,}113 & 3{,}099 \\\\\nHeld-out Social Sciences & 1{,}352 & 3{,}320 \\\\\nHeld-out Math \\& Decision Sci. & 165 & 434 \\\\\n\\midrule\n\\textbf{Total} & \\textbf{12{,}499} & \\textbf{27{,}393} \\\\\n\\bottomrule\n\\end{tabular}\n\\end{table}\n\n\\subsection{Outcome distributions}\n\n\\begin{figure}[!htbp]\n  \\centering\n  \\includegraphics[width=\\linewidth,height=0.85\\textheight,keepaspectratio]{figures/fig_outcomes_v0.pdf}\n  \\caption{Distribution of the primary outcome, rarefied field breadth ($O_{2r}$, $m=50$), over the 7,203 of 12,499 frame concepts that have at least 50 papers in the $t_0{+}6$..$t_0{+}8$ outcome window. (a) Histogram of $O_{2r}$ in 1-field bins. The dashed orange line marks the median (4.73) and the light-blue band the interquartile range [3.41, 6.20]. (b) $O_{2r}$ against the raw field count. Rarefied breadth is nearly independent of outcome-window volume ($\\rho = -0.06$), whereas the thresholded raw count grows with volume ($\\rho = 0.41$).}\n  \\label{fig:outcomes}\n\\end{figure}\n\n", "numLines": 80, "startLine": 1, "totalLines": 808}}
